items.title: COP31 Climate Summit Opens in Türkiye
items.one_liner: The COP31 climate summit has kicked off in Türkiye, focusing on climate action, adaptation finance, and energy.
items.why: Highlights international policy discussions regarding climate adaptation finance for developing regions.
items.action: Monitor COP31 announcements concerning urban climate adaptation funding gaps.

items.title: EU Water Sector Digitalisation Action Plan
items.one_liner: The EU Commissioner for Environment hosts a roundtable to discuss the draft action plan on water sector digitalisation.
items.why: Informs water management, urban hydrology, and digital monitoring approaches relevant to water yield and urban planning.
items.action: Review the draft action plan details to examine digital water management indicators.
items.status_evidence: discuss the draft action plan on digitalisation in the water sector

items.title: 33 Cities Commit to Climate Urban Planning Model
items.one_liner: Thirty-three cities have committed to a new climate urban planning model by 2035.
items.why: Connects global urban planning commitments directly to local heat mitigation and green infrastructure strategies.
items.action: Identify the planning criteria used by these cities to benchmark local urban frameworks.

items.title: Draft National Restoration Plan in EU
items.one_liner: A draft national restoration plan was formally submitted to the European Commission.
items.why: Provides methodological insights on large-scale ecosystem restoration and habitat quality tracking for planning.
items.action: Examine the restoration plan's metrics for monitoring ecosystem service recovery.

items.title: City of Kamloops Climate Action Grants
items.one_liner: Applications are open for the 2027 City of Kamloops Climate Action Grants.
items.why: Illustrates municipal funding mechanisms for local climate adaptation and urban environmental actions.
items.action: Review grant priorities to see what local urban interventions municipalities prioritize.

items.title: New Zealand Climate Action Fund Open
items.one_liner: Applications have opened for Climate Action Fund projects in New Zealand.
items.why: Offers a potential reference point for grant structures supporting community-level climate and green projects.
items.action: Check project eligibility guidelines to understand supported community climate interventions.

note: Selected updates, not comprehensive coverage. Status is unverified unless supported by the quoted official excerpt.
